integrity: The infinite claim is proved by a morphic decomposition, an induction covering every prefix length between consecutive powers of two, and a desubstitution occurrence lemma that supplies a unique escaping factor at every next power-of-two boundary. A separate verifier directly replays the greedy definition through 256 symbols and checks the structural lemmas at higher substitution levels.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is specific to the period-doubling fixed point and the least-failing-prefix greedy rule of Schaeffer and Shallit. No corresponding classification is claimed for other automatic sequences or other greedy heuristics.
title: Greedy period-doubling attractors occur exactly at \(2^m-1\)
